roles.example: The roles and permissions page of a manager or the superadmin: the base roles of the application with their permissions to see, and the additional roles of the organization to create, edit, duplicate and delete, their permissions chosen in foldable sections by resource, each permission with its description, as far as the backend allows each row; a base role can be duplicated too, as the start of a new additional role. The demo backend serves no roles, so the list stays empty.
